facts.fact: 这是 Sam 和 Jordan 几小时前谋划好的完美陷阱，只待时机成熟就行动。
Sam 认为对攻击者不加惩罚就永无安宁，因此决心改变自己。
facts.anchor: History had shown Sam that no consequences for an attacker meant no peace for him.

facts.fact: Max 在黄色皮划艇上嘲讽 Sam，说脚踏船在运河 Tranquil Cove 一侧。
facts.anchor: “I think the paddleboats are on the Tranquil Cove side of the canal, mate,” he said.

facts.fact: Avery 承认自己也默许了把 Sam 从 Silverback 滑道推下的事，还反怪 Sam 胆怯。
facts.anchor: It wasn’t all his doing. I gave him the thumbs up,” Avery added.

facts.fact: 导览员 David 用扩音器说前方二十码运河分叉，左边是高难度急流河道。
facts.anchor: In twenty yards, the canal splits into two,” David said through his bullhorn.

facts.fact: 因 Sam 划得吃力，Avery 和 Max 拐进左侧河道后消失，报复计划落空，Sam 反而松了口气。
facts.anchor: Avery and Max were out of sight. Jordan was silent. And Sam was relieved.

facts.fact: 当晚家人在高档餐厅 Sera Blu 吃饭，Sam 本想吃自助披萨缓解报复失败的失落。
facts.anchor: Sam had been hoping for an all-you-can-eat pizza buffet to take the edge off his failed revenge plot.

facts.fact: Lily 因 Sam 拒绝谈 Nan 的信、不肯分享而伤心，说他只在乎自己并气冲冲离席。
facts.anchor: “I just thought you’d be curious, Sam. But it turns out all you care about is yourself.”
